## Change and scientific boundary

Describe the change. Separate author assertions, exact computation, formal proof,
source/statement fidelity, and scholarly novelty.

## Evidence

- [ ] Tests and commands with actual exit codes
- [ ] New adversarial/negative cases
- [ ] Source, policy and dependency invalidation considered
- [ ] No new acceptance from labels, unsigned receipts or model output
- [ ] Required CI passed (not merely skipped)
- [ ] Sensitive manuscript/model data excluded from public logs/artifacts
